Suggested one-line fix (Lead's call): extend the expected list with the two later rows. DEFECT-B (flaky class, fixture race): tests/integration/deployment/bootstrap-smoke.test.ts and release-cli.test.ts share the ONE fixture database zeck_local on the ONE ZECK_PG_TEST_URL server, and vitest's default file parallelism runs them concurrently — bootstrap-smoke's first test tears zeck_local down to establish the pristine state mid-drill, and release-cli's setup migrate/record subprocesses then fail closed ('startup failed: the authoritative PostgreSQL endpoint is unavailable: database "zeck_local" does not exist'). Reproduction: each file green in isolation (release-cli 11/11, bootstrap-smoke 10/10, both measured on the 16.15 rail); the two files launched concurrently against the same rail → release-cli 10 failed | 1 passed (exit 1) while bootstrap-smoke passed 10/10; the same cascade appeared in the full railed parallel run (below). Classification: pre-existing base test-infra property (per-file drills sharing one fixture DB), NOT a chain defect — the tools failed closed exactly as designed; suggested fix (Lead's call): serialize the two files or give release-cli its own fixture database/environment name. Neither defect touches src/, deploy tools, apps/dashboard/, sdk/ or examples/.
